name: Tennis return
scope: Continuous first 20 seconds of the frozen tennis student recording, seed 97001. Multiple incoming-ball cycles, including a failed return, with no robot resets or cuts. Incoming balls are relaunched between cycles; no opponent policy. Visual hands restored in replay; original court, ball and racket states retained.
lighting: Studio v4: white sky; contrasting terrain, world-anchored skate grid, or original tennis-court colors according to scene. Original robot albedo retained.
rendering: Exact recorded actual robot and object states. Nearest timestamp resampling only; maximum quantization is half of one source interval, plus source timestamp precision. No training, simulator stepping, teacher queries or reference-pose playback during rendering.

visual_hands.transforms: Exact upstream commented visual-hand transforms on wrist_yaw_link
